text: Gates are built to be safe. A gate always lands you **inside the far gate's own frame** and never digs, builds or clears anything to make room.
If there is nowhere to stand inside the far frame, the trip refuses and the Pulse goes back into the keystone.
The far end is held loaded for **ten seconds** around your arrival, so a partner in an unloaded chunk still answers. Only a [Wayanchor](wayanchor) keeps it loaded longer.

pages.title: When a gate breaks
text: Break a keystone and its partner is released at once and goes dark. Anyone standing within 16 blocks of the partner is told which gate was lost.
**/tribalpower gate list** shows every gate and what it answers. **/tribalpower gate unlink <name>** cuts a thread by hand.
To relink, use a compass, chalk or sigil again as in [Way Gate](way_gate).

pages.title: When a gate will not work
text: - **"This keystone has no frame around it"**: a frame block is missing or misplaced. Check against the pattern.
- **Needs Pulse**: charge the keystone; lighting and travel both come from its own store.
- **Goes dark by itself**: a redstone signal is held on it, or a Far Gate lost its Loom voice.
- **"The thread finds nothing"**: the gate is lit but not linked.
Crouch and right-click a keystone with this book for its full state.
